notes.title: YUMMY CHICKEN DRAGON RE:HATCHED
notes.content:
[h3]YUMMY CHICKEN DRAGON RE: HATCHED update is coming soon![/h3]

New levels and new horrors are added, and all in 3D!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42216346/e4710f10c8d78435fec84c24d0472eefd697919d.png[/img]

Meet and talk to your family! Other Chicken Dragons inside the of the nest

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42216346/3efcc150806745446e664f11d0c7b1a67304108d.png[/img]

Things are what they seem in the world... something is happening outside of your nest...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42216346/80a0c2fd056cde14aaf68a208920d8df9d48d29c.png[/img]



Watch as the story hatches into something far more... sinister.... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42216346/8048bf2e0a809a3a84fcda6980883ef595908c3a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42216346/1a302de67ebec106f809cc8f9fbdc22190aebcec.png[/img]

Once the update comes out there will be an option to go back to the original release of the game!

notes.title: POP TO THE SHOPS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42216346/322246cd6f9ce91330cbdf7aa51abc992898c8fd.png[/img]
If you liked the craziness of YUMMY CHICKEN DRAGON, you should check out the sequel called "POP TO THE SHOPS" It's directly inspired by WEIRDCORE and DREAMCORE, and is in active development. Check out the WiredConnection ITCH.io page
https://wiredconnection.itch.io/poptotheshops

notes.title: Launch Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42216346/cc3de55b5c6eb491473f9fad6ddeb1e1a5665b4f.png[/img]

Just wanted to say thank you to everyone that has played and the game,I plan on waiting on more player feedback in the forms and updating the game during the time i work on other things. I will upload the soundtrack to YouTube sometime soon so that you may enjoy the music whenever you want to,

I will also be creating a thread where you can post any bugs or issues that you may have come across.

Thank you again everyone!
